approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce a Paragraph identifier assembled from numeric components belonging to two cited paragraphs.
Validate explicit dotted Paragraph/Para, Clause and Article identifiers as atomic typed values before generic numeric checks.
Keep a claimed typed clause identifier with the same exact RFI/Submittal identity or source finding.
Allow an exact Paragraph locator to ground only its corresponding Paragraph identifier.
Do not infer unlabelled or undotted values, hierarchy, applicability or authority.
title: Ground project-answer clause identifiers
objective: Prevent an explicit dotted Paragraph, Clause or Article identifier from being recombined or borrowed across workflows, source findings or an exact Paragraph locator.
